# This week the goal is to explore analysis of point clusters in a number of different ways

__As always the first steps are to load libraries and data__

```{r}
# Libraries
# install.packages("spatstat")
library(spatstat)
library(here)
library(sp)
library(tmap)
library(sf)
library(tmaptools)
```


```{r}
# Read in the data
LondonBoroughs <- st_read(here::here("Week_6_prac_and_hw/statistical-gis-boundaries-london/statistical-gis-boundaries-london/ESRI/London_Borough_Excluding_MHW.shp"))
```

Let's now inspect the LondonBorough data.
```{r}
# Quick Map
library(stringr)
BoroughMap <- LondonBoroughs %>%
  dplyr::filter(str_detect(GSS_CODE, "^E09"))%>%
  st_transform(., 27700)

qtm(BoroughMap)
```
```{r}
# Summary Stats
summary(BoroughMap)
```
